Replacement firmware for the EEVblog 121GW, with an emulator of the meter and the 121GW Companion app.

### Downloads

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `firmware-<tag>.zip` | the firmware: install it with the Companion, or copy `EEVBlog.bin` to the SD card ([how](https://github.com/zombu4/121GW-Open-Firmware/blob/main/firmware/HARDWARE_TEST.md)) |
| `121GW-User-Manual-<tag>.pdf` | the user manual |
| `121GW-Open-Firmware-Emulator-<tag>-<platform>` | the emulator: macOS (Apple chips), Windows, Linux ([how to start it](https://github.com/zombu4/121GW-Open-Firmware/blob/main/emulator/START.md)) |
| `121GW-Companion-<version>-<platform>` | the Companion app: Windows, macOS, Linux |
